proof_groups.proof_strategy: Prove the suffixed DLL segment and dispatch helpers once in the group-local case_lib. Then prove entail_wit_1 by anchor case analysis and split, the four returns by choosing their resource-complete first disjunct and rebuilding xizi_dll, and the two derivations by choosing the unchanged nodes and applying sepcon/wand adjunction.
proof_groups.natural_language_proof_strategy: The sentinel query uses the intact circular segment; member queries use a first-occurrence cut. The C return has only two logical cases: the following pointer is the sentinel, so the suffix is empty and the value is zero, or it starts a nonempty suffix and equals that suffix's first abstract value. In both cases the split segments rejoin to the original DLL. Derived contracts keep the same nodes; dispatch reduces to sentinel first_value under equality and to member next_value after proving the member is not the sentinel.
proof_groups.grouping_reason: All seven witnesses belong to the same function and share the DLL segment/dispatch helper family. A single group prevents duplicate suffixed helpers and remains safely below the twelve-witness controller bound.
